title: Find an appointment
summary: Find a patient's appointments on any date.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Type the patient or the title
steps.details: By the patient's name, phone, email or ID, or by the appointment title. It searches all dates; choosing a result takes the calendar to that day and opens the appointment.

steps.title: Choose the appointment
steps.details: You see the past and future appointments that match. Choosing one takes the calendar to that day and opens the appointment.
